ref_issue.title: S21: chant workspace as blocks spike (a workspace block reading chant's read contract)
ref_issue.body:
**Blocks:** nothing yet (a milestone follows only on a go)

*Blocks track. What it means to render a chant workspace (`~/dev/intentius/chant`, or any directory with a `chant.workspace.json`) as illogical blocks: members you can see, panes and agents opened on a member, and chant's gates and drift arriving as attention. illogical becomes one more reader of chant's read contract, beside hud and behold (chant `ws-017`, `ws-052`: "a reader other than hud gets everything hud gets").*

--------

- **The idea:** a `Workspace` block type (a new `BlockType` variant, `crates/proto/src/lib.rs:575`). The daemon runs `chant workspace … --json` on the block's machine and draws the members. Every client gets the result through `describe`, `call`, events and MCP.

  | chant | illogical |
  |---|---|
  | the workspace | a `workspace` block, the tab's index |
  | a member (name, dir, kind, `because`) | a card in the block, with status |
  | a member's `dir` | the cwd for terminal, editor, diff, file and agent blocks opened "on" it |
  | a nested `workspace` member | a collapsed card that opens as its own block |
  | `generated` entries, `check --generated` | staleness on the card; the action runs the generator in a pane |
  | records (`blockedBy`, `ready`, drift on pins) | a records list, and attention on drift |
  | an op stopped at a gate (`chant run` exits 3) | attention with a reason and an *Approve* action (M24) |
  | an agent session bound to one member (`ws-048`) | an agent block with that member's cwd and its spec query as context |

- **What the read contract gives today** (checked 2026-10-02 against chant `6fcb9f34`, 0.87.0, on chant's own workspace and `reference-workspace/`):
  - **`workspace ls --json`** works: `$schema` `…/workspace/ls/v1`, `contract: 1`, members, groups and a summary. About 1.2 s, 14 KB for chant's 26 members. This is enough to draw the cards.
  - **`workspace status <env> --json`** works: each member's latest release per env from the `chant/lifecycle` ledger (`…/status/v1`). Read-only, never fetches.
  - **`workspace check --format json`** works (`…/check/v1`), with WSP diagnostics per member and file/line. `check --json` prints a different document: `{lock, ok, findings, declaration}`, with no `$schema`. The spike should use `--format json`.
  - **`workspace records --json`** works where the declaration names kinds (`reference-workspace`: `…/records/v1`, with `blockedBy`, `ready`, `provenance`, `digest`). W-002 comes back `blockedBy: W-001 in-progress`. On chant's own root it fails: `--kind <kind file> is required`, because the declaration names no record kinds, so `--kind docs/design/decisions/…` is needed there.
  - **`workspace graph --json`** returns the document, but on chant only members of kind `chant` run. 25 of the 26 are `other` and come back `skipped` with `kind-not-run`, so the graph of chant's own repo is nearly empty. In `reference-workspace` the `delivery` member failed with `command-failed`. That was my install (`npm ci --ignore-scripts` left the docker lexicon's `generated/` unbuilt), not chant.
  - **`workspace graph --intent <path> --json`** works (`…/intent/v1`): the history, decisions and pinned artifacts behind one file. This fits a file or diff block (*why is this line like this*).
  - **`workspace lineage --json`** fails without `.chant/workspace.lock.json`, and neither workspace has one.
  - **Gates: no workspace-level read.** `chant run <op> --json` / `--progress-json` (NDJSON) and `run list` / `run status` exist per op, and pending gates live in the gate ledger (`packages/core/src/lifecycle/gate-ledger.ts`). But nothing lists every pending gate across members as one document. Neither checked workspace has an `*.op.ts`, so this is unexercised.

- **Questions:**
  1. Can the daemon draw a useful workspace block from `ls` + `status` + `check --format json` + `records` alone, with nothing in chant changed?
  2. Which chant runs (`ws-021`)? The workspace's own `node_modules/.bin/chant`, npx at the pinned version, or a `chant` on PATH, and on a VM tab, the one on that machine. My first run failed outright because chant had no `node_modules` (`Cannot find package 'zod'`). The block has to say so, not show an empty workspace.
  3. Freshness: every read is a one-shot process of about 1.2 s (`ws-017` turned down a chant daemon). Re-read on file changes under the declared dirs, on a timer, or on demand? What does 4–5 reads per refresh cost?
  4. Gates: do we read the gate ledger ourselves, run `chant run status` per op, or ask chant for a `workspace gates --json` read-contract document? The last is the right one if it's small. Draft that request for Jake to file on chant, don't file it.
  5. Is the workspace one block with member cards, or a layout of member blocks? Try both on chant (26 members, mostly lexicons) and on `reference-workspace` (4).
  6. Where does it stop being illogical and start being hud (`ws-052`: review actions, quorum, comment mode belong to hud)? Write down the line.

- **Method:** a standalone crate in `spikes/s21-chant-workspace`. It shells out to chant, parses the documents against their published schemas (`intentius.io/chant/schemas/workspace/*/v1`), and prints the block's `describe` JSON and a text rendering of the cards. Then wire one throwaway `Workspace` block into a dev daemon (`--socket` explicitly) on a branch, open it on `~/dev/intentius/chant` and on `reference-workspace`, and from a card open a terminal and an agent on one member. Fake a pending gate with a toy `*.op.ts` in a scratch copy of `reference-workspace`.
- **Done when:** README with go/no-go; read timings; a list of what the block shows and which document each field comes from; the answers to questions 2–6; and a draft chant issue for anything we'd need from the read contract (gates, `check --json` vs `--format json`).

ref_comment.body:
**Done 2026-10-02: go.** README with the numbers, answers and screenshots: `spikes/s21-chant-workspace/README.md` (merged in 636d01a). The throwaway block is on branch `s21-workspace-block`.

- **The read contract alone is enough.**
  - `workspace status <env> --json` already carries every member's pending gates with chant's approve command, so the "gates: no workspace-level read" above was wrong. No chant change is needed.
  - On a dev daemon, a gated op shows as `needs_input` about 1 s after `chant run` exits. *Approve* runs `chant approve` and clears it. *Shell*, *Agent* and *Changes* open on a member, and a nested workspace opens as a second block.
- **Cost:** a full read is about 7.5 CPU-s (four tsx startups). So the block polls a git fingerprint (about 0.1 CPU-s) every 3 s while drawn, and reads in full only on change: 0.4% of a core when idle.
- **The daemon had no node** (mise sets it up in `.bashrc`). See #74.
- **Cards, not member blocks.**
- **Approve:** the owner and editors, each as themselves (#75, decided).

Follow-ups:
- #73 M34, the workspace block;
- #74, the shell environment for blocks that run your tools;
- #75, approve as owner or editor;
- #76, drafts for chant (Jake files those himself).

ref_issue.title: M35: studio app blocks (the app, hud's questions and gates as attention)
ref_issue.body:
**Blocked by:** #73 (M34: gate cards, gate attention as a type, the phone's gates-first sheet) and #75 (approve as a person). **From:** S22 (`spikes/s22-apps`, PLAN's "Studio apps track": go).

*Studio apps track. A studio box (arugula-salad's studio, or planter's on Fountain) as a block: the app in the frame, and everything the box waits on as illogical attention. That means its agent's questions and its chant gates. A box's repo is a chant workspace, but illogical reads it **through hud in the box**, never by running chant there: illogical can't run commands in a hosted box, and a full chant read (about 7.5 CPU-s) is too much for a 2 GB box when hud already pays it and pushes changes.*

---

- **The block:** a web-page block that knows it's a hud box. Config `{box url, app name, studio}`. The frame is the box itself (it's already its own origin, so no block site or proxy). S22: `illogical open <entry link>` worked once the cookie was partitioned.
- **Getting in:**
  - illogical needs a studio token, to list a person's apps and mint the owner's `/__enter` link (`POST /api/apps/:name/open` is passkey-session only today). *For studio.*
  - The link is never kept. Today it sits in the block's URL bar and config. Mint it each time the frame needs one. After the first load the partitioned cookie lasts a year.
  - Restore after a reboot, and a second device, both still untried.
- **studio's door: partitioned cookies.** hud's session (and the door's `box_next`) as `SameSite=None; Secure; Partitioned`. Without it the frame gets 401 in Chrome and Firefox; with it, 200, including Chrome with third-party cookies blocked. *For studio* (`door-patch.sh` is the stand-in). Check on purpose that hud's write routes still refuse cross-origin JSON with `None`.
- **Questions → asks** (S22's `bridge.mjs`, into the daemon):
  - follow `/__hud/api/chat/stream` for each of `/__hud/api/tabs`;
  - a `hud-chat-queue` frame's `question` becomes an ask on the block itself, `source: "hud"`, project from the box's repo, not the follower's cwd;
  - an answer goes to `/__hud/api/chat/answer`; a question gone from the queue withdraws the card.
  - S22: 11 ms to illogical, 48–74 ms back, 33 ms to withdraw.
  - Needs `Api::Ask` (and so `POST /api/panes/{id}/ask`) to take browser blocks. It's terminal-only today (`no terminal %2`).
- **Gates → attention:**
  - read from hud's work board (`GET /__hud/api/work`, which reads `workspace status` and so has every gate, whoever ran it), refreshed when hud's live feed changes (`/__hud/api/live/stream`), not polled;
  - shown with M34's gate type and card (`source: hud`).
  - **Open:** hud can approve only a gate from a run it started (`POST /__hud/api/deploy/runs/:id/approve`; those runs live in memory). A gate from the steward's or a terminal's `chant run release` has no hud route. Either hud gets one (`approve` for any pending gate in `workspace status`, `--actor` from its roster), or *Approve* opens hud's work page in the frame. *For hud.*
- **Who answered (#75):** illogical's answer or approval names the person who clicked, in hud's chat and in chant's ledger. hud records the follower's own player today (the owner). Decide here: each person's own hud player link (`hud share --role player`), or hud trusting a follower's "answered in illogical by X". View-only guests are refused.
- **Records:** linked, not reviewed. *Decisions*, *Work* and *Intent* open hud's pages in the frame (`/__enter?…&to=/__hud/work`). Record review stays hud's (`ws-052`).
- **Swarm:** kind `app`, project the box's app; the box's questions and gates bundle with it.
- **Ways in:** *Open a studio app…* in the pane menu and the picker (from the studio token), `illogical app [NAME]`, and an MCP `open_app`.
- **Later:** planter's boxes (Fountain: the same hud, reached through planter's relay); *New app* in the tab menu (studio's `POST /api/apps`); a terminal into the box when it's on your own wispd.

**Tests:** the follower against a fake hud (queue frames, answer, withdraw, expiry); a daemon test for an ask on a browser block; an e2e with a fake box (a page plus hud's routes) framed from another site.

**Done when:** on geek, a real studio box opens as a block from the picker; its agent's question shows on the swarm's rail and on the phone; answering in illogical carries on the agent's turn, with hud naming who answered; a release waiting at `ship` shows as attention and can be approved; and the block comes back after a daemon restart without a stored link.

**Found on the way (arugula-salad, for Jake to file):** hud's panel never mounts on the template's page, framed or not (the client is injected in `<head>` and looks for `<body>`); a template clone on geek gets `widgets.wtf` while `~/box/domain` says `studio.arugula.io`.

body:
**Added from S22 (studio apps, `spikes/s22-apps`): write gate attention against a gate, not against chant.**

A studio box's repo is a chant workspace too (members `app`, `delivery`, `box`; its release stops at chant's `ship` gate). The studio app block (#85, M35) will get its gates from hud in the box (hud's work board, `GET /__hud/api/work`, reads `workspace status`), not by running chant. illogical can't run commands in a hosted studio box or a planter box on Fountain.

So that both kinds of block land in the same place on the swarm:

- Keep the gate as its own type: `{member, op, gate, env, since, expires, approvals, needed, command}`, plus `source` (chant on this host, or hud in a box). The `needs_input` reason, the bundle key and the card come from that type, not from the reader.
- *Approve* goes through the source: here `chant approve … --approver <person>` (#75), and in M35 whatever hud offers.
- The phone's gates-first sheet and the swarm's rail don't care where a gate came from.

Nothing else in M34 changes. In particular the workspace block stays for local workspaces and isn't widened to boxes. "A workspace on a VM tab" would work for a box on your own wispd (the box has node in `~/opt/node` and its own chant), but M35 is the way in for boxes in general.

ref_issue.title: M36: Forgejo pull request blocks (attention, diff, checkout, drafts as asks)
ref_issue.body:
**Blocked by:** #87 (S23), #73 (M34's gate `source`) and #85 (M35's `Api::Ask` on non-terminal blocks). **Plan:** PLAN's "Forge track", M36.

---

`BlockType::Forge` with `{provider: forgejo, host, repo, kind: pr, number}`:

- **Reads** through the provider adapter, polled while drawn or while it has attention. State: title, body, author, labels, draft, base/head, mergeable, reviews, checks, the newest timeline events.
- **Log:** the timeline as an event stream in `blocks/%N/`, so `history` and `search` find it.
- **Attention** through M34's gate `source` (`forge`) and M24's reasons:
  - review requested from you → `ask`;
  - your checks red → `failed`, with *Rerun checks*;
  - changes requested or a mention → `input`;
  - merged, or green → `done`.
- **Methods:**
  - `comment`, `approve`, `request_changes`, `merge`, `rerun_checks`, `refresh`. An agent's write becomes a draft ask; a person's goes out as them. Owner and editors only.
  - `diff`: an M11 diff block on `merge-base..head` in a worktree of the head.
  - `checkout`: a terminal block in that worktree.
- **`capture --text`:** the PR as text.
- **Ways in:** `illogical pr [URL | REPO#N | N]`, *Open pull request…*, PR links in terminals, MCP `open_pr`, and the swarm (kind `pr`).
- **Web:** `blocks/forge.tsx`, plus the phone sheet (what waits on you first) and a TUI line.

**Tests:** adapter units on S23's fixtures; daemon tests for attention, drafts and viewer refusal against a fake Forgejo (with ETags); e2e.

**Done when:** on geek, a real PR on this repo's Forgejo opens as a block. A review requested from Jake reaches the rail and phone within about a minute, and approving it from the phone shows on Forgejo as Jake. Red checks show as *Failed* with *Rerun checks*. An agent's `comment` waits as a draft until Jake sends it.

ref_issue.title: Workspaces and studio apps, end to end on geek (#74, M34, M35)
ref_issue.body:
*Tracker for the run that makes chant workspaces and studio apps work as illogical blocks, end to end on geek. Brief: `BRIEF-workspaces-studio.md` (in the main checkout, uncommitted).*

**Order (illogical):** #74 (shell environment) → #73 (M34, with #75) → #85 (M35). Each is merged into illogical's main locally when its "done when" passes on geek; main is not pushed.

**arugula-salad PRs (for Jake / Aaron to merge):**
- hud: refuse cross-site writes (prerequisite for the door's `SameSite=None`): https://github.com/arugula-salad/hud/pull/734
- studio: partitioned cookies at the door: https://github.com/arugula-salad/studio/pull/291
- studio: a personal token for illogical (list apps, mint the owner's entry link): https://github.com/arugula-salad/studio/pull/292
- hud: approve any pending gate in `workspace status`, `--actor` from the roster: https://github.com/arugula-salad/hud/pull/735
- hud: a trusted follower names who answered or approved (#75's rule): https://github.com/arugula-salad/hud/pull/736

**Merged into illogical main (local):** d1a9513 #74, c88c1e7 M34, edddc1a M35, plus PLAN as-built commits 0c4da71 and 71d955d. See the last comment for the full Needs Jake list.

**Needs Jake:**
- Merge the arugula-salad PRs above (hud's CLAUDE.md says Aaron merges).
- The trusted-follower design in hud is a maintainers' call; per-person player links are the fallback.
- Deploying the studio/hud changes to the real studio, and a real studio token for illogical.
- Pushing illogical's main and a release.

ref_comment.body:
**Live, 2026-10-02 (Jake: merge, deploy, push, release):**

- **arugula-salad PRs merged:**
  - hud#734 (56446b0), hud#735 (0bd17d4), hud#736 (0a4cf0e, rebased onto main after #735);
  - studio#291 (30df2bc), studio#292 (c994b20);
  - studio#293 (eeea772): a fix that template builds needed. `chant-lexicon-fly` takes `chant-lexicon-otel@*`, so fresh installs pulled otel 0.101 against chant 0.96, and `chant run` failed in every new box. This is also why the box smokes fail on main. The real fix belongs in chant (lexicon-fly should give otel a real range), for Jake to file.
- **studio.arugula.io:**
  - **The lobby** rolled through CI and Flux (pin 4ff0e7b). `GET /api/apps` now answers 401 without a token.
  - **The box template:** `arugula-box-template` was rebuilt from studio main with a hud bundle built from hud main 0a4cf0e (`~/.local/share/studio/bundle-hud-0a4cf0e.tgz`, kept separate so Arcade's bundle is untouched). It has the partitioned door, hud 0a4cf0e and otel 0.96.0, and passed its self-test. New apps get all of it.
  - **The 5 existing apps are untouched** (Jake chose template only). `migrate` doesn't update hud, so an existing box needs the new hud copied in before its door is migrated.
  - **A failed first rebuild** (before studio#293) left the template half-built for a few minutes. It was restored from a backup clone, `arugula-box-template-bak-1002`, which is still on wispd (cold). Delete it once a new app checks out.
- **illogical v0.7.0:** tagged on 84b5e9b and published. geek, jake-mini and jake-air are upgraded (install.sh; geek's panes kept). #73, #74, #75 and #85 are closed.

**To check on the phone (Jake):**
1. On studio.arugula.io, make a new app, so it's built from the new template.
2. In studio's settings, make a personal token. Then on geek: `illogical studio login https://studio.arugula.io` and paste it.
3. For "who answered", run `hud share --role follower` in the new box, then `illogical studio follower <app>` with that link. I can do this step once the app exists.
4. *Open a studio app…* from a pane's menu, ask its agent something, and answer and approve from the phone.
